content.text: We meet on the roof of Hale Hall on clear nights. Everyone is welcome, even if you have never looked through a telescope.

content.text: while packing up we saw a light flashing from out at Lantern Point: three flashes, a pause, two, a pause, three. Over and over. The old lighthouse has been dark for years. Mira thinks someone is signalling.
